summary.name: AI Agents in 2024 (E2B blog)
summary.one_liner: An E2B blog post collecting predictions, favorite 2023 AI products, and 2024 resolutions from eight AI developers and startup founders.
use_cases: Reading expert opinions on where AI agents are heading
Finding AI tools developers used in 2023
Getting ideas for AI product directions
summary.what_it_does: The page is a short roundup of interviews with eight people, including founders of Superagent, Rubric Labs, Fine, Taskade, AgentHub, Basedash and Athena Intelligence, plus a student contractor at OpenAI. It gives each person's prediction for AI agents and AI products in 2024. It also lists their favorite or most-used AI product of 2023, such as Perplexity, Cursor, Raycast AI, Langchain and the OpenAI API. The last section covers each person's AI-related resolution for 2024. The page is opinion-based and contains no product features or pricing of its own.
notable: Predictions from eight AI founders and developers in one post
Lists favorite 2023 AI tools such as Perplexity, Cursor and Raycast AI
Page is published by E2B, which promotes its cloud runtime for AI agents
caveats: Opinion piece: predictions are personal views, not verified outcomes
Written at the end of 2023, so the 2024 forecasts are dated
